entities.name: Merfolk
entities.description: A species of aquatic humanoids with gills who can breathe air; the characteristic species of the color blue, with many plane-specific varieties.

entities.name: Merrows
entities.description: The fish-tailed merfolk of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor; razor-witted traders on Lorwyn, murderous cutthroats and thieves on Shadowmoor.

entities.name: Selkies
entities.description: Seal-bodied merfolk present only in Shadowmoor, masters of magic and divination.

entities.name: Undines
entities.description: The curious, secret-hoarding merfolk of Eldraine.

entities.name: Jalpari
entities.description: The reclusive merfolk of Avishkar, roused from the depths by the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Tritons
entities.description: The two-legged, partially amphibious merfolk of Theros who worship Thassa.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: The merfolk of Ixalan, a major faction whose empire was eclipsed by the Sun Empire and who now live nomadically in the jungle.

entities.name: Vodalian Merfolk
entities.description: Merfolk of the Voda Sea around Sarpadia who once had an extensive empire later overrun by Homarids.

entities.name: Saprazzan Merfolk
entities.description: Dominarian merfolk taken to Mercadia by Ramos, who built the floating city Saprazzo and aided the Weatherlight crew.

entities.name: Rootwater Merfolk
entities.description: Aggressive, eel-like merfolk of the rootwater of the Skyshroud Forest.

entities.name: Merfolk of the Copper Conch
entities.description: Mutated-elf merfolk created by the Sages of Lat-Nam to guard Lat-Nam island.

entities.name: Razorfin Hunters
entities.description: A crossbreed of goblins and merfolk beneath the seas of Dominaria, probably mutated by the Rathi Overlay.

entities.name: Gaea's Skyfolk
entities.description: Flying creatures of part-merfolk, part-elven origin, an indirect product of the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Sages of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The creators of the Merfolk of the Copper Conch.

entities.name: Sygg
entities.description: A merrow whose school is Paperfin/Razorfin.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: An Otarian whose treachery cost the merfolk much of their Mer Empire.

entities.name: Ramos
entities.description: A dragon engine that took the Saprazzan merfolk to Mercadia.

entities.name: Talrand
entities.description: A warlord who conquered the merfolk kingdom of Shandalar and sought power over the telepathic drakes.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: A planeswalker who made a magical ward keeping the Skyshroud Forest warm on Keld.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: A merfolk who was highest-ranking speaker of the Simic Combine.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: A character of Eldraine whose group was helped across a river by four undines.

entities.name: Indrelon
entities.description: Someone Rowan Kenrith's group traveled to meet.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The sea god of Theros, worshiped by tritons.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: A Ravnican guild that many resurfaced merfolk have joined.

entities.name: Homarids
entities.description: Creatures who overran much of the Vodalian territory.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion of Dominaria that led Dominarians to cooperate.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The later invasion that roused the jalpari and drove Shadowmoor merrows to the Dark Meanders.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The blast whose climate changes let the Homarids overrun Vodalian territory.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: The event that planeshifted Rath's rootwater to Keld and likely mutated Razorfin Hunters.

entities.name: Merrow Lanes
entities.description: The system of rivers across Lorwyn controlled and maintained by merrows.

entities.name: Dark Meanders
entities.description: The deepest parts of the subterranean rivers of the Merrow Lanes.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The plane (with Shadowmoor) home to merrows and selkies.

entities.name: Shadowmoor
entities.description: The dark half of Lorwyn-Shadowmoor where merrows turn to theft and selkies live.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose merfolk are natural explorers able to sense the Roil.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: A plane where the River Heralds guard Orazca and the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: A plane whose merfolk were thought extinct beneath the city.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane of the undines.

entities.name: Enclave
entities.description: The largest settlement of Zendikari merfolk, on an island in the bay of the Umara River on Tazeem.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: A Zendikar phenomenon that only merfolk can innately sense.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: A place on Ixalan that merfolk believe must be hidden from trespassers.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: An artifact on Ixalan that merfolk believe must be hidden.

entities.name: Power Matrix
entities.description: A relic the Saprazzan merfolk worshiped as holy and gave to the Weatherlight crew.

events.summary: Gaea's Skyfolk arise, part merfolk and part elven, as an indirect product of the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: The Skyfolk were partially of merfolk and partially of elven origin

events.summary: The Sages of Lat-Nam create the Merfolk of the Copper Conch to guard Lat-Nam.
events.quote: The Merfolk of the Copper Conch were created by the Sages of Lat-Nam

events.summary: Through Laquatus's treachery the Otarian merfolk lose most of their empire to the cephalids.
events.quote: the merfolk lost much of their Mer Empire to the cephalids due to Laquatus 's treachery

events.summary: After the Sylex Blast, the Homarids overrun much of the Vodalian territory.
events.quote: much of their territory was overrun by the Homarids

events.summary: Four undines help Rowan Kenrith's group across a river to meet Indrelon in exchange for knowledge and secrets.
events.quote: Four undines assisted Rowan Kenrith 's group across a river to meet with Indrelon in exchange for knowledge and secrets.

events.summary: The Merrow of Lorwyn change after the Aurora, becoming more fishlike.
events.quote: After the Aurora, merrows became more fishlike

events.summary: Overcome by covetousness, Shadowmoor merrows become murderous cutthroats and thieves.
events.quote: Overcome by covetousness, Shadowmoor merrows became murderous cutthroats and thieves who steal from the other species of Shadowmoor

events.summary: Shadowmoor merrows migrate to the Dark Meanders during the New Phyrexian Invasion and adapt to it.
events.quote: After migrating to the Dark Meanders during the New Phyrexian Invasion

events.summary: The Saprazzan merfolk are taken to Mercadia by Ramos to survive the Brothers' War and build Saprazzo.
events.quote: were taken to Mercadia by the dragon engine Ramos to ensure the species' survival during the Brothers' War

events.summary: The Saprazzans relinquish the Power Matrix to the Weatherlight crew upon learning it is part of the Legacy.
events.quote: relinquished it to the Weatherlight crew when they learned it was part of the Legacy

events.summary: The Saprazzans aid the crew and the Cho-Arrim in overthrowing the Kyren regime.
events.quote: They then aided the crew and the Cho-Arrim in overthrowing the Kyren regime

events.summary: Freyalise creates a ward keeping the Skyshroud warm so the rootwater merfolk survive on Keld.
events.quote: were it not for the intervention of Freyalise , who created a magical ward in the forest to keep it warm

events.summary: Sinkholes let Ravnican merfolk resurface and many join the Simic Combine.
events.quote: However, massive sinkholes enabled them to resurface, and many have joined the Simic Combine and risen to leadership positions

events.summary: The Shandalar merfolk kingdom is conquered by the warlord Talrand.
events.quote: the merfolk kingdom was conquered by the warlord Talrand
